card.name: Single or simplified dosing wording
card.fires_on: Words that stress oneness or simplicity, such as single, once-daily, a day after one dose, and simple. Seen mostly in dosing schedules, and sometimes in general talk of simplified systems.

modes.label: Single daily dose
modes.description: Words meaning one dose per day, such as single, daily, or day in once-daily phrases.
modes.example: may have their total daily dose replaced with Naproxen Sodium Controlled-Release Tablets as a single<< daily>> dose.

modes.label: Simple or unified in general text
modes.description: Words about simplicity or few elements outside of dosing.
modes.example: clear and<< simple>> to understand; applied consistently, proportionate

card.writes: It pushes toward words about simplifying, unifying and consolidating, and away from words about separate or individual items.
card.plain: It notices wording that says something is a single, once-a-day or simplified arrangement.
